name: Senior adjudicator
design: Lean elderly male with pale sandy reptilian hide, heavy brow folds, long exposed mandibular tusks, grey dreadlocks to mid-back. Long formal charcoal gown with broad ochre central panel, structured layered cloth collar, bronze rank medallion with abstract geometry, soft waist sash. Holds a plain flat circular officiating disk low in left hand, right resting at waist. Dignified slight stoop.
